name: Dream Big Gymnastics Camps
description_short: School-vacation day camp at Dream Big Gymnastics in Cranston, RI. Campers learn gymnastics skills, do a ninja warrior obstacle course and make an arts and crafts project. Camps run 8:30am to 4pm and cost $75 per day.
